m: सं-शान , सं-शित &c. See सं-√ शो.
सं-शान n. N. of various Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
सं-शान्त mfn. thoroughly pacified or allayed, MBh.
extinguished, destroyed, dead, MBh.; R. &c.
सं-˚शान्ति f. extinction, VarBṛS.
सं-शारुक mfn. breaking down (in अ-स्˚) Kap.
सं-√ शास् P. -शास्ति, to direct, instruct, summon, call upon, Br.; GṛS.; to arrange or put in order with (instr.), TS.
सं-शास् See सु-संशस्.
सं-˚शासन n. direction, ŚāṅkhBr.
सं-˚शासित mfn. directed, instructed, Cat.

सं-√ शॄ P. -शृयाति, to smash to pieces, crush, Br.; ĀśvGṛ. : Pass. -शीर्यते (aor. -शारि; pf. -शश्रे), to be crushed, break down, RV.; AV.; to be dissipated or routed, fly in different directions, MBh. : Desid. See सं-शिशरिषु.

सं-√ शी Ā. -शेते (pr.p. -शयान; ind.p. -शय्य), to grow languid, become feeble, MW.; to waver, be uncertain or irresolute or doubtful, hesitate, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to despair of (loc.), Kathās.; to lie down for rest, MW.; (P. -शयति), to differ in opinion or disagree about (acc.), Yājñ., Sch.
a: संशी — {c2c} A. 1 To waver, be in doubt or suspense, be uncertain or irresolute संशय्य कणीदिषु तिष्ठते यः Ki. 3. 14, 42.; Bv. 2. 115. --2 To lie down for rest, sleep.

m: सं-शीलन n. regular practice, habitual performance, Sarvad.
frequent intercourse with (gen.), Kāv.
सं-शीन mfn. id., Car.
सं-शीत , सं-शीन. See सं-√ श्यै.
सं-शीत mfn. congealed, frozen, cold, cool, ŚārṅgS.
सं-शीति f. = सं-शय, doubt, uncertainty, Kād.; Hcar.
a: संशीतिः — f. Doubt; न हि मे संशीतिरस्या दिव्यतां प्रति K. 132.

m: सं-शून mfn. (√ श्वि) much swelled, swollen, Bhaṭṭ.
सं-√ शंस् P. -शंसति, to recite together, AitBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
सं-शंसा f. praise, commendation, ŚāṅkhBr.
सं-√ शङ्क् Ā. -शङ्कते, to be very suspicious of (acc.) or with regard to (loc.), MBh. iv, 568.
सं-√ शब्द् (only ind.p. -शब्द्य and Pass. pr. p. संशब्द्यमान), to exclaim, MBh.; to speak about, mention, ib.
सं-शब्द m. calling out, provocation, MBh.
speech, BhP.
mention, Vop.
a: संशब्दः — Mention, reference.

m: सं-˚शब्दन n. making a sound, calling out, MW.
mentioning, Dhātup.
praising, eulogizing, ib.
a: संशब्दनं — 1 Making a sound. --2 Praising. --3 Calling out to. --4 Referring to.

m: सं-˚शब्द्य See above and अ-संशब्द्य.
सं-√ 2. शद् Caus. -शातयति, to cause to fall down, crush, break to pieces, MBh. iii, 865.
सं-√ शक् P. -शक्नोति, to be capable, be able to (inf.), AV.; BhP.; (with न) not to succeed with, not to be a match for (instr. or loc.), TS.; AV.
सं-शकला ind. killing, slaughter, W.
with -√ कृ, p. -करोति, g. ऊर्य्-आदि (cf. शकला).

सं-√ 1. शम् P. -शाम्यति. to become thoroughly calm or pacified, be comforted, R.; to be appeased, make peace with (instr. with or with out सह), MBh.; to be extinguished, ŚBr.; ChUp.; to be allayed, cease, MBh.; to be or become ineffective, BhP.; to calm, allay, ŚBr. : Caus. -शमयति, to tranquillize, calm, pacify, ŚāṅkhŚr.; MBh. &c.; to bring to an end, settle, arrange, Pañcat.; to extinguish, R.; to bring to rest, remove, destroy, kill, MBh.
a: संशम् — {c4c} P. 1 To be calm. --2 To be allayed or extinguished, disappear; सत्त्वं संशाम्वतीव मे Bk. 18. 28. --3 To be removed. --Caus. 1 To mitigate. --2 To settle, decide; Pt. 1. 376.

m: सं-शम m. complete case, comfort, satisfaction, ŚBr.; Bhaṭṭ.
सं-˚शमनीय See वास्तु- and संशोधन-स्˚.
सं-˚शमन mf(ई)n. allaying, tranquillizing, Suśr.
removing, destroying (see पाप-स्˚)
सं-˚शमन n. pacification, Kām.
a sedative, Suśr.
सं-√ शप् P. Ā. -शपति, ˚ते, to take an oath together, swear, curse, imprecate, MBh.
सं-शप्त mfn. ‘sworn together’, cursed, Kād.

s: puM, samayAt saMgrAmAdanivarttI । ityamaraH ॥ samayAt kulAcArAt SapaTAdvA saMgrAmAdanivarttino'parANmuKA apalAyamAnAScAkroSanti te saMSaptakAH । SaperBAve kte SaptaM samyak satyaM SaptaM yezAM te saMSaptakAH । iti BarataH ॥ nArAyaRIsenAviSezaH । iti mahABAratam ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 1 । 187 । “tadASrOzaM cAsmadIyAn mahAraTAn vyavasTitAnarjjunasyAntakAya । saMSaptakAn nihatAnarjjunena tadA nASaMse vijayAya saYjaya ॥” etadvaDavfttAntAdikaM mahABArate droRaparvvaRi 17 aDyAyamAraBya drazwavyam ॥)
v: pu॰ samyak SaptamaNgIkAro yasya kap । pratijYAya saMgrAmAdanivarttini sEnye nArAyaRIye sEnyaBede ca tezAM pratijYA yaTA “brAhmaRAMstarpayitvA ca nizkandattvA pfTak pfTak । gASca vAsAMsi ca punaH samABAvya parasparam । prajvAlya kfzRavartmAnamupagamya raRe vratam । tasminnagnO tadA cakruH pratijYAM dfqanilayAH । SfRvatAM sarvaBUtAnAmuccErvAcovaBAzire । te ca canaYjayavaDe pratijYAYcApi cakrire । ye vE lokAScAnftinAM ye ca vE brahmavAtinAm । madyapasva ca lokA ye gurudAraratasya ca । brahmasvahAriYcaScEva rAjapiRqApahAriRaH । SaraRAgataM vA tyajatA yAcamAnaM taTA GnataH । agAradAhinAYcEva ye ca gAM niGnatAmapi । apakAriRAYca ye lokA ye ca brahmadvivAmapi । svaBAryyAmftukAlezu yo mohAnnABigacCati । SrAdDarmaTunikAnAYca ye cApyAtmA pakAriRAm । nyAsApahAriRAM ye ca SrutaM nASayatAYca ye । klIvena yuDyamAnAnAM ye ca dInAnusAriRAm । nAstikAnAYca lokA ye'gnimAtfparityajAm । tAnApnuyAmahe lokAn ye ca pApakftAmapi । yadyahatvA vayaM sarve nivarttema DanaYjayam । tena cAByarditAstrAmuNKibe mahi parANmuKAH । yadi tvamukaraM loke karma kuryyAma saMyuge । izwAn lokAn prApta yAma vayamadya na saMSayaH । evamuktrA tato rAjaMste'myavarttanta saMyuge । Ahvayanto'rjunaM vIrAH pitfjuzwAM diSaM prati” BA॰ dro॰ 17 a॰ ।
m: सं-˚शप्तक m. a soldier or warrior sworn with others not to fly or give up fighting (till some object is gained), one bound by an oath to kill others (pl. a band of conspirators or confederates such as Tri-garta and his brothers who had sworn to kill Arjuna but were killed themselves), MBh.
a: संशप्तकः — [सम्पक् शप्तसंगीकारो यस्य कप् Tv.] 1 A warrior sworn never to recede from a contest and kept to prevent the flight of others. --2 A picked warrior. --3 A brother in arms. --4 A conspirator who has taken an oath to kid another.

k.v: संशप्तकास्तु समयात्संग्रामादनिवर्तिनः। रेणुर्द्वयोः स्त्रियां धूलिः पांसुर्ना न द्वयो रजः॥

m: सं-˚शप्तक—वध-पर्वन् n. N. of the section of the MBh. (vii, 17) describing the above.
सं-शप्त—वत् mfn. one who has sworn with others, one who has cursed (also as pf. ‘he has sworn or cursed’), Kathās.
सं-शर , सं-शारुक. See सं√ सॄ, p. 1118 col. 1.
सं-शर m. crushing, breaking, rending, VS.; TBr.

s: klI, (saM + SF + lyuw .) raRAramBaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥ (saMrakzaRam । yaTA, kAmandakIye । 6 । 4 । “lokAnugrahamanvicCan SarIramanupAlayet । rAjYaH saMSaraRaM DAma SarIraM DarmmasADanam ॥”)
v: na॰ saMSIryyate'nena sam + SF--karaRe lyuw । raRAramBe SabdamA॰ ।
m: सं-शरण n. resorting to, seeking, refuge with (gen.), Kām.
सं-˚शरण n. the commencement of a combat charge, attack, L. (prob. w.r. for सं-सरण).
a: संशरणं — Commencement of a combat, attack, charge.

m: सं-श˚याक्षेप m. ‘removal of doubt’, a partic. figure of speech, Kāvyād. ii, 163; 164

v: tri॰ saMSaya + atyarTe Aluc । saMSayayukte hemaca॰
m: सं-˚शयालु mfn. disposed to doubt, doubtful or sceptical about (loc.), Naiṣ.

a: संशयान, संशयालु, संशयितृ — a. Doubtful, irresolute, uncertain, wavering.

m: सं-श˚यानुमिति f. N. of wk.
सं-श˚यानुमिति-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
सं-श˚यापन्न mfn. beset with doubt, dubious (-मानस mfn. irresolute in mind), W.

s: tri, (saMSayamApannaM mAnasaM yasya yatreti vA .) saMSayavizayaH । saMSayayuktaH । tatparyyAyaH । sAMSayikaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ dve saMSayavizaye sTARvAdO । saMSayamApannaH sAMSayikaH zRikaH । saMSayamApannaM mAnasaM yatra sTARvAdO sa taTA । saMSayamApannaM mAnasaM yasya sa taTeti zazWyanyapadArTatve saMSayitari puruzAdAvapye tacCabdadvayapravfttiH syAt । iti BarataH ॥
m: सं-श˚यापन्न—मानस mfn., irresolute in mind

k.v: पूज्यः प्रतीक्ष्यः सांशयिकः संशयापन्नमानसः। दक्षिणीयो दक्षिणार्हस्तत्र दक्षिण्य इत्यपि॥

m: संशयातिशय m. exaggeration in the way of suggesting doubts, Kāvyād.
सं-श˚यात्मक mfn. consisting of doubt, dubious, uncertain, Pañcat.

v: pu॰ saMSaya Atmani yasya । mandigDAntaHkaraRe “saMSayAtmA vinaSyatIti” “saMSayAtmA nibaDyate” ।
m: सं-श˚यात्मन् mfn. having a doubtful mind, a sceptic, Bhag.; Sarvad.
सं-श˚यावह mfn. causing danger, dangerous to (gen. or comp.), MBh.

s: puM, (saM + SI + ac .) sandehaH । ityamaraH ॥ tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “sa saMSayo BavedyA DIrekatrABAvaBAvayoH । sADAraRAdiDarmmasya jYAnaM saMSayakAraRam ॥” iti BAzAparicCedaH ॥ “saMSayaM lakzayati saMSata iti । ekaDarmmikavirudDaBAvABAvaprakArakaM jYAnaM saMSaya ityarTaH । sADAraReti uBayasADAraRo yo DarmmastajjYAnaM saMSayasADanam । yaTA uccEstaratvaM sTARutvasADAraRaM jYAtvA ayaM sTARurna veti sandigDe । evamasADAraRajYAnaM saMSayakAraRam । yaTA SabdatvaM nityAnityavyAvfttaM Sabde gfhItvA Sabdo nityo na veti sandigDe । vipratipattistu Sabdo'nityo na veti SabdAtmikA na saMSayakAraRaM SabdavyAptijYAnAdInAM niScayamAtrajanakatvasvABAvyAt । kintvatra Sabdena kowidvayajYAnam janyate saMSayastu mAnasa eveti । evaMjYAne'prAmARyasaMSayAdvizayasaMSayaH । evaM vyApyasaMSayAdapi vyApakasaMSaya ityAdikaM boDyam । kintu saMSaye DarmmijYAnaM DarmmIndriyasannikarzo vA kAraRamiti .” iti tawwIkA sidDAntamuktAvalI ॥
v: pu॰ sam + SI--ac । sandehe ekasmin DarmiRi BAvABAvayoH virudDaDarmadvayasya vA sandehe । yaTA parvato vahnimanni vA, ayaM sTARurvA puruzoveti । “sa saMSayo BavedyA DIrekatrAnAvaBAvayoH । sADAraRAdiDarmasya jYAnaM sa SayakAraRam” BApA॰ “ekaDarmikavirudDaBAvABa vapra kArakaM jYAnaM saMSayaH ityarTaH । sADAraReti । uBayasADAraRo yo DarmastajjYAnaM saMSayakAraRam । yaTA uccEstaratvaM sTARutvasADAraRaM jYAtvA ayaM sTARurna beti sandigDa । evam asADAraRajYAnaM tatkAraRam । yaTA SabdatvaM nityAnityavyAvfttaM Sabde gfhItvA Sabdo nityo Ra veti sandigDe । vipratipattistu Sabdo nityo na vetyA diSabdAtmikA na saMSayakAraRas । SabdavyAptijYAnAdinAK niScayamAtrajanakatvasvABAvyAt । kintu tatra Sabdena kowidvayajYAnaM janyate । saMSayastu tatra mAnasa eveti । evaM jYAne prAmARyasaMSayAd vizayasaMSaya iti । evaM vyApyasaM SayAdapi vyApakasaMSaya ityAdika boDyam । kintu sa Saye DarmijYAnaM DarmIndrisannikarzo vA kAraRamiti” si॰ mu॰ । “samAnAnekaDarmopapattervipratipatterupamaSyanupalabDyavyavasTAtaSca viSezApekzo vimarSaH saMSayaH” nyAyasU॰ “samAnaDarmopapatterviSezApekzo vimarSaH saMSaya iti sTARupuruzayoH samAnaM DarmamArohapariRAho paSyan pUrvadfzwaYca tayorviSezaM buButsamAnaH kiMsvidityanyatarannAvaDArayati yadanavaDArayati tadanaScaDAraRaM jYAnaM saSayaH samAnayorDarmamupalaBe viSezamanyatarasya nopalaBe ityezA budDirapekzyA saMSayasya pravarttikA varttate, tena viSezApekzo vimarSaH saMSayaH । anekaDarmopapatteriti samAnajAtIyamasamAnajAtIyaYcAnekaM tasyAnekasya DarmopapatterviSezasyoBayaTA dfzwatvAt samAnajAtIyeByo'samAnajAtIyeByaScArTA viSezyante । SanDavattvAt pfTivI abAdiByo viSezyate guRakarmaByaSca, asti ca Sabde viBAgajatvaM viSezaH, tasmin dravyaM guRaH karma veti sandehaH viSezasvoBayaTA dfzwatvAt kiM draGyasya sato guRakarmaByo viSeza AhosvidguRasya sata iti aTa karmaRaH sata iti viSezApekzA anyatamasya vyavasTApakaM DarmannopalaBe iti budDiriti । vipratipatteriti vyAhatamekArTadarSanaM vipratipattiH vyAGAto viroDo'sahaBAva iti । AstyAtmetyekaM darSanam nAstyAtmetyaparam, va ca ladBAvAsadBAvO sahEkatra samBavataH, na cAnyatarasADako heturupalaByate tatra tattvAnavaDAraRaM saMSaya iti । upalabDyavyavasTAtaH svalvapi saccodakamupalaByate taqAnAdizu marIcizu vA'vidyamAnamudakamiti tataH kvacidupalaByamAne tattvapyavasyA pakasya pramARasyAnupalabDeH kiM sadu palaByate aTAsaditi saMSayo Bavati । anupalabDyavyavasTAtaH sacca nopakaByate mUlakIlakodakAdi, asaccAnutpannaM virudDaM vA, tataH kvacidanupalaByamAne saMSayaH kiM sannopalaByate latAsaditi saMSayo Bavati viSezApekzA pUrvavat, pUrvaH samAno'nekaSca Darmo jYeyaKyaH, upalabDyanupalabDI punarjYAtfsTe, etAvatA viSezeRa punarvacanam, samAnaDarmADigamAt samAnaDarmopapatterviSezasmftyapekzo vimarSa iti, sTAnavartA lakzaRavacanamiti sasAmam” vA॰ BA॰ । “saMSaya iti sakzyanirdeSaH vimarSa ityatra viSabdo viroDArTaH maSirjYAnArTaH ekasmin DarmiRIti pUraRIyaM tena ekaDarmiRi viroDena BAvABAvaprakArakaM jYAnaM saMSayaH tata kAraRamuKena viSesalakzaRAnTAha samAnetyAdi upapattirjYAnaM taTA ca samAsasya virudDakowidvayasADAraRaDarmasya jYAnAdityarTaH । anekaDarmaH asADAraRaDarmaH tajjYAnAdityarTaH । taTA ca sADAraRaDarmavadDarsijYAnajanyo'sADAraRaDarBavarBavallarmijYAnajanyaScetyarTaH, viprAtipattirvirudDakowidvayoparaDAvataH SabdaraKAdityarTaH yadApi Sabdarava ga saMSayakatvaM tapApi” SabdAtkAwidvayopasTitO mAnasaH saSaya iti vadanti । upalabDerjYAnasya anupalabDervyatirakajYAnasya yA'vyavasTA maDimayakatvAnirdDAraRa prAmARya saMSaya iti Palito'rTaH, nanye tu upalabDyavyavasTA prAmARyasaMSayaH anupalabDirviroDiBvAmaH tadavyavasTA tataH saMSaya ityAhuH । vastutastu grAmARyasaMSayasya na saMSayahetutvaM kiM tvagfhItApAmARyakaScAvrasya viroDitayA sati prAmARyasaMSaye tajjYAnasTAciroDitayA sADARaDarmadarSanAdita eva saMSayotpattiriti । upalabDItyAdikaM tAdfSasTale saMSayo na BavatItyetAvanmAtrapara cakAro vyApyasaMSayasya vyApakaSasaMSayahetutvaM samuccivotIti vadanti viSezApekzaH kowismaraRasApekzaH । vastutastu saMSayaDArAvAhikatvaM syAdata Aha viSezeti viSezaM viSezadarSanam apekzate viavArttakarvaMna taTA ca viSezadarSananivarttyatvakaTanamuKena viSezAdarSanyasaMSaya itmuktama” vftitiH sa ca saMSayo dviviDaH yaToktama “dviviDaH saMSayo vahirvizayako'ntarvizayakaSca bahirvizayaSco'pi dfSyAmAnaDarmiko'dfSyamAnaDarmikaSca tatra qaSyazAnaDArmako yaTA UrdDatvaviSizwasya DarmiRo darSanAt ayaM ravARuH puruzo yeti । adfSyamAnaDarmiko yaTA araRye JAwAdyantarite yogavaMyAdivizARamAtradarSanAt ayaM gOrgavayo veti । vastutastatrApi vizARaDarmika eva sandeho vizARaBidaM gosambanDi gavayasambanDi saMti vivakzAmAtrAddvEviDyABiDAnam । yat sAmAnyaM saMSayAhetustaQanekatra dfzwaM saMSAyakama ekatra DarmiRi vA dfzwaM saMSayaheturityatra praTamAM viDAmAha” upa॰ vfttiH । “idrantu voDyaM saMSayaSca pratyakzarUpaH sannikarzajanyatvAt ataevoktaM “parIkzajYAnamanAhAryyaM niScayaSceti sidDAntAditi” । saMSaye ca uBayaprakAratAnirUpitA viSezyatA ekEva । samuccaye tu viSezyatAdvayamiti” gaQADaraH ।
m: सं-शय &c. See सं-√ शी.
सं-शय m. (ifc. f(आ). ) lying down to rest or sleep, L.

uncertainty, irresolution, hesitation, doubt in or of (loc., acc. with प्रति, or comp.; संशयः, with Pot., ‘there is doubt whether’; न स्˚, नास्ति स्˚, नात्र स्˚, न हि स्˚, नास्त्य् अत्र-स्˚ &c., ‘there is no doubt’, ‘without doubt’), ĀśvŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a doubtful matter, Car.
(in Nyāya) doubt about the point to be discussed (one of the 16 categories), IW. 64
difficulty, danger, risk of or in or to (gen. loc., or comp.), ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. &c.
a: संशयः — 1 Doubt, uncertainty, irresolution, hesitation; मनस्तु मे संशयमेव गाहते Ku. 5. 46; त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेता न ह्युपपद्यते Bg. 6. 36. --2 Misgiving, suspicion. --3 Doubt or indecision (in Nyāya), one of the 16 categories mentioned in the Nyāya philosophy; एकधर्प्रिकविरुद्धभावामावप्रकारकं ज्ञानं संशयः; it is also regarded as one of the two kinds of अयथार्थज्ञान --4 Danger, peril, risk: न संशयमनारुह्य नरो भद्राणि पश्यति H. 1. 7; याता पुतः संशयमन्यथैव Māl. 10. 13; Ki. 13. 16, Ve. 6. 1. --5 Possibility. --Comp. --आत्मन् a. doubting, sceptical. --आपन्न, --उपेत, --स्थ a. doubtful, uncertain, irresolute. --गत a. fallen into danger; Ś. 6. --छेदः solution of a doubt, decision, --छेदिन् a. clearing all doubt, decisive; Ś. 3.

k.v: अध्याहारस्तर्क ऊहो विचिकित्सा तु संशयः। सन्देहद्वापरौ चाथ समौ निर्णयनिश्चयौ॥

m: सं-शय—च्छेद m. the solution of doubt (˚द्य mfn. relating to it), Ragh.
सं-शय—च्छेदिन् mfn. clearing all doubt, decisive, Śak.
सं-शय—च्छेद्य mfn., relating to the solution of doubt
सं-शय—गत mfn. fallen into danger, Śak.
सं-शय—कारणार्थापत्ति-पूर्व-पक्ष-रहस्य n. N. of Nyāya wk.
सं-शय—कारणार्थापत्ति-रहस्य n. N. of Nyāya wk.
सं-शय—कर mf(ई)n. causing doubt or risk, dangerous to (comp.), Śiś.
सं-शय—पक्षता-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
सं-शय—पक्षता-वाद m. N. of wk.
सं-शय—परीक्षा f. N. of wk.
सं-शय—स्थ mfn. being in uncertainty, doubtful, W.

सं-शय—सम-प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
सं-शय—तत्त्व-निरूपण n. N. of wk.
सं-शय—वादार्थ m. N. of wk.
सं-शय—वाद m. N. of wk.
सं-˚शयिन् mfn. doubtful, dubious, questionable, MW.

m: सं-˚शयित mfn. irresolute, doubtful about (comp.), KātyŚr.; R.
subject to doubt, uncertain, dubious, questionable, MBh.; Kām.
सं-˚शयित n. doubt, uncertainty, MBh.
a: संशयित — a. 1 Doubtful, uncertain. --2 Doubted, questioned. --3 Risked, hazarded, endangered, exposed to peril or danger; संशयितजीविता ते शरीरावस्था Māl. 2.

m: सं-˚शयितव्य mfn. to be called in doubt, dubious, problematical, Śaṃk.
सं-˚शयितृ mfn. one who hesitates, a doubter, sceptic, L.
सं-श˚योच्छेदिन् mfn. resolving doubts, Hit., Introd.
सं-श˚योपमा f. a comparison expressed in the form of a doubt, Kāvyād. ii, 26
सं-श˚योपेत mfn. possessed of uncertainty, doubtful, uncertain, MW.
सं-श्चाय Nom. (fr. prec.), A. ˚यते, g. भृशादि.

v: sam + Syu--Svi--vA vA॰ qati । kuhake uRAdi॰ ।

सं-श्-चत् n. deceit, trick, illusion, juggling, W.
a: संश्चत् — n. Trick, jugglery, illusion. --m. A juggler.

m: सं-शृङ्गी f. (fr. सम् and शृङ्ग) a cow whose horns are bent towards each other, MaitrS.
सं-शिशरिषु See सं-√ शॄ.
सं-शिशरिषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to rend or tear, Nir. vi, 31.
सं-शिश्रीषु See सं-√ श्रि.
सं-शिश्रीषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to have recourse to (acc.), Bhaṭṭ.
सं-शिश्वन् mf(अरी)n. having one calf in common (said of cows), RV. (= एक-शिशुक, Sāy.)
सं-√ शिञ्ज् Ā. -शिङ्क्ते, to utter a shrill sound, ŚBr. : Caus. -शिञ्जयति, to clash together (trans.), ib.
सं-√ शिक्ष् Caus. -शिक्षयति, to teach (two acc.), BhP.; to try, test, Dhanaṃj.
सं-शिस् f. direction, invitation, AV.
सं-˚शितात्मन् mfn. one who has completely made up his mind, firmly resolved, MBh.

s: tri, (saM + So + ktaH .) samyaksampAditam । vratavizayakayatnavAn । yaTA saMSitaM vratam । samyak sampAditamityarTaH । saMSito brAhmaRaH । vratavizakayatnavAnityarTaH । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥
v: tri॰ sams + So orate ittvama । 1 sampAditavratavizayakayatne 2 tadvati tri॰ sE॰ kO॰ ।
m: सं-शित mfn. (often wrongly written शंसित or संसित) whetted, sharpened, ŚBr.
pointed, sharp (see comp.)
ready, prepared for or resolved upon (loc.), AV.; MBh. &c.
made ready, well-prepared, all right (applied to things), VS.; AV.
fixed upon, decided, firmly adhered to, rigid (as a vow), Mn.; MBh. &c.
completing, effecting, diligent in accomplishing, W.
सं-शित m. N. of a man g. गर्गादि (cf. सांशित्य)
a: संशित — p. p. 1 Sharpened, aroused. --2 Sharp, acute --3 Thoroughly completed, effected, accomplished. --4 Decided, well-ascertained, determined, certain. --5 Effecting, diligent in performing. --Comp. --आत्मन् a. one whose mind is thoroughly matured or disciplined. --व्रत a. one who has fulfilled his vow.

m: सं-शित—तपस् mfn. exposed or subjected to painful austerities or mortifications (said of a Śūdra), MBh.
सं-शित—वाच् mfn. using harsh or sharp language, MBh.

v: tri॰ saMSitaM samyak sampAditaM Gratamanena । samyaksampAditavrate ।
m: सं-शित—व्रत mfn. (सं-श्˚) firmly adhering to a vow, faithful to an obligation, honest, virtuous, ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
सं-शित—व्रत m. a Ṛṣi, Gal.
सं-शिति f. excessive sharpening, AitBr.
सं-शिष्ट mfn. (√ शिष्) left remaining, TS.
सं-√ श्लाघ् Ā. -श्लाघते, to vaunt or boast of (instr.), MBh.

s: puM, (saM + Sliza + GaY .) AliNganam । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 133 । 17 । “saMSlezaYca parastrIBirdasyuretAni varjayet ॥”) melanam ॥ (yaTA mArkaRqeye । 37 । 15 । “anantarESca saMSlezamaByetya tadanantaram । tezAmanyatamErBfrtyaH samAkramyAnayadvaSam ॥”)
v: pu॰ sam + Sliza--GaY । 1 AKiNgane amaraH 2 sampanDamAtre ca ।
m: सं-श्लेष m. (ifc. f(आ). ) junction, union, connection, close contact with (instr. or comp.; ˚षं √ लभ्, ‘to attain, participate in’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
embracing, an embrace, Kālid.
a joint, SāmavBr.
a bond, thong, MBh.
a: संश्लेषः — 1 Embracing; an embrace; वशिनां हि परपरिग्रहसंश्लषपराङ्मुखी वृत्तिः Ś. 5. 28. --2 Union, connection, contact.

k.v: संवीक्षणं विचयनं मार्गणं मृगणा मृगः। परिरम्भः परिष्वङ्गः संश्लेष उपगूहनम्.।

m: सं-˚श्लेषण mf(ई)n. joining, connecting, ŚāṅkhBr.
सं-˚श्लेषण n. clinging or sticking to, Dhātup.
the act of putting together or joining, Suśr.
a means of binding together, bond, cement &c., ŚāṅkhBr.; ĀpŚr.; Uttarar.
a: संश्लेषणं --णा — 1 Pressing together, --2 Means of binding together. --3 Connection, tie, bond.

m: सं-˚श्लेषिन् mfn. clasping, embracing, joining together, ŚāṅkhBr.
सं-˚श्लेषित mfn. (fr. Caus.) joined together, united, attached, MBh.

सं-√ श्लिष् P. Ā. -श्लिष्यति, ˚ते, to stick or attach one's self to (acc.), Baudh.; Kām.; R. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 46, Sch.); to clasp, embrace, MBh.; R. &c.; to bring into close contact or immediate connection with (instr.), MBh. : Caus. -श्लेषयति, to connect, join, put together, unite or bring into contact with (instr. or loc.), Āpast.; Hariv.; Kathās.; to transfer to (loc.), Kull. on Mn. viii, 317; to attract, Kām.
a: संश्लिष् — {c4c} P. 1 To clasp or press together. --2 To adhere or cling to. --3 To join, unite. --Caus. To unite, join, connect together.

s: tri, ASlizwaH । militaH । saMpUrvvaSlizaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
v: tri॰ sam + Sliza--kta । 1 AKiNgite 2 sambadDe ca ।
m: सं-श्लिष्ट mfn. clasped or pressed together, contiguous, coherent, closely connected with (instr. with and without सह acc., or comp.), ŚBr. &c. &c.
coalescent, blended together, Prāt.
confused, indeterminate (as an action which is neither good nor bad), MBh.
endowed with, possessed of (instr.; किंचिज् जीविताशया, ‘having a slight hope of life’), Pañcat.
सं-श्लिष्ट m. a kind of pavilion, Vāstuv.
सं-श्लिष्ट n. a heap, mass, multitude, R.
a: संश्लिष्ट — p. p. 1 Clasped or pressed together, joined, united. --2 Embraced. --3 Adjoining, lying close or contiguous to. --4 Furnished or endowed with, having. --5 Related, connected together; Pt. 2. 127.

m: सं-श्लिष्ट—शरीर-कारिन् mfn. (pl.) putting their bodies together i.e. dwelling or living together, MBh.
सं-श्लिष्ट—कर्मन् mfn. not distinguishing between good and evil actions, MBh. xii, 4220 (v.l. सं-क्लिष्ट-क्˚)
सं-√ श्लोक् P. -श्लोकयति, to celebrate in Ślokas or hymns, praise, BhP.
सं-√ शो P. Ā. -शिशाति, -शिशीते (once श्यति, RV. i, 130, 4), to whet or sharpen thoroughly (Ā. ‘one's own weapons’), RV.; TS.; ŚBr.; to urge, excite, speed, make ready, prepare, RV.; AV.; Br.; KātyŚr.
सं-शोभित mfn. (fr. Caus.) adorned or shining with (instr.), Ṛtus.

s: klI, (saM + SuDa + lyuw .) saMSudDiH । iti ratnamAlA ॥

सं-शोधन n. purification or a means of p˚, Suśr. refining, clearing, W.
paying off, correcting, ib.
a: संशोधनं — Purification, cleanness &c.

m: सं-शोधन—शमनीय mfn. treating of purifying and calming remedies, Suśr.

m: सं-˚शोधित mfn. completely cleansed and purified &c.
cleared off, paid, Kathās.
सं-शोक (prob.) m. = स्वेद, ‘sweat’, ‘moist heat’, in next.
सं-शोक—ज mfn. produced from moist heat (cf. स्वेद-ज), Bādar.
सं-शोष m. complete drying, drying up, VarBṛS.
सं-˚शोषण n. id., MBh.; Suśr.
सं-˚शोषण mfn. making dry, drying up, Car.
सं-˚शोषिन् mfn. drying up, making dry, Subh. (said of a partic. form of fever, Bhpr.)
सं-˚शोषित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made thoroughly dry, dried up, MW.
सं-श्रान्त mfn. (√ श्रम्) completely wearied, languid, exhausted, MBh.; BhP.
सं-श्राव &c. See सं-स्राव.
सं-श्राव m. (ifc.) hearing, listening to, Kauś.
सं-˚श्रावक m. a hearer, disciple, Kāraṇḍ.
सं-˚श्रावम् See अ-संश्रावम्.
सं-˚श्रावयितृ m. (fr. Caus.) an announcer, crier, proclaimer, KauṣUp.
सं-˚श्रावयितृ—मत् mfn. having an announcer, ib.
सं-˚श्रावित mfn. (fr. id.) read out or aloud, Kathās.
सं-˚श्राव्य mfn. audible (in अ-संश्राव्यम् v.l. for ˚श्रावम्, q.v.)
not to be caused to hear anything, not to be informed of (acc.), R.
सं-√ श्री P. -श्रीणति, to join or unite or connect with, cause to partake of (instr.), TāṇḍBr.
सं-श्रद्-√ धा (only ind.p. -धाय), to have complete faith in, believe, BhP.

v: pu॰ sam--Sru--ap । aNgIkAre amaraH । GaY । saMSrAvI'pyatra pu॰ ।
m: सं-श्रव m. hearing, listening (loc., ‘within hearing’), MBh.; Mālatīm.
assent, promise, agreement, L.
सं-श्रव mfn. audible (see विदूर-संश्रव).
a: संश्रवः — 1 Hearing attentively. --2 A promise, an agreement, engagement.

m: सं-˚श्रवण n. the act of hearing or listening, MBh.; Suśr.; Sarvad.
(ifc.) hearing about, Hariv.
range of hearing, earshot (loc., ‘within hearing, aloud’), MBh.; R.; Car.
a: संश्रवणं — 1 Hearing. --2 The ear.

m: सं-˚श्रवस् n. perfect glory or renown, Vait.
सं-˚श्रवस् (सं-), m. N. of a man (having the patr. Sauvarcanasa), TS.
सं-˚श्रव˚सः साम n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
सं-श्रयात् ind., ‘in consequence of’
सं-श्रयात् ind., ‘by means or help of’

ASrayaH । yaTA, stutA surEH pUrvva maBozwasaMSrayAttaTA surendreRa dinezu sevitA । karotu sA naH SuBaheturoSvarI SuBAni BadrARyaBihantu cApadaH ॥” iti mArkaRqeyapurARe devImAhAtmye 5 aDyAyaH ॥ (ASrayasTAnam । yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 41 । 6 । “aho niScatano rAjA jIvalokasya saMSrayam । Darmmo satyavratraM rAmaM vanavAse pravatsyati ॥”)
m: सं-श्रय m. (ifc. f(आ). ) conjunction, combination, connection, association (ifc. ‘joined or connected with’), relationship or reference to (ifc. ‘relating to’, ‘referring to’; ˚यात् ind. ‘in consequence of’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
going or resorting or betaking one's self to any person or place (loc. or comp.), going for refuge or protection, having recourse to (cf. कलि-स्˚), MBh.; Pañcat. &c.
league, alliance, leaguing together for mutual protection (one of the 6 Guṇas of a king), Mn. vii, 160; Yājñ. &c.
a refuge, asylum, shelter, resting or dwelling-place, residence, home (ifc. ‘residing with’, ‘living or dwelling or resting in or on’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
devotion to, attachment to (ifc. ‘devoted or attached to’; ˚यात् ind. ‘by means or help of’), MBh.; R. &c.
an aim, object, MW.
a piece or portion belonging to anything, MBh.
N. of a Prajā-pati, R.
a: संश्रयः — 1 A resting or dwelling place, residence, habitation; परस्परविरोधिन्योरेकसंश्रयदुर्लभं V. 5. 24; R. 6. 41; oft. at the end of comp. in this sense and translated by ‘residing with’, ‘relating or pertaining to’, ‘with reference to’; ज्ञातिकुलैकसंश्रयां Ś. 5. 17; नौसंश्रयः R. 16 57; U. 3. 17; मनोरथोऽस्याः शोशमौलिसंश्रयः Ku. 6. 60; द्विसंश्रयां प्रीतिमवाप लक्ष्मीः 1. 43; एकार्थसंश्रयमुभयोः प्रयोगं M. 1. --2 Seeking protection or shelter with, fleeing for refuge, forming or seeking alliance, leaguing together for mutual protection; one of the 6 guṇas or expedients in polities; see under गुण also; Ms. 7. 160. --3 Resort, refuge, asylum, protection, shelter; अनपायिनि सश्रयद्रुमे गजभग्ने पत्ननाय वल्लरी Ku. 4. 31; Me. 17; Pt. 1. 22.

m: सं-˚श्रयणीय mfn. to be resorted to, to be sought for protection (-ता f.), Kām.
सं-˚श्रयणीय—ता f.
सं-˚श्रयण n. (ifc.) clinging to, attachment, MBh.
सं-श्रय—कारित mfn. caused by alliance, Mn. vii, 176.
सं-श्रयिन् mfn. having recourse to, seeking protection
सं-श्रयिन् m. a subject, servant, Kām.
(ifc.) dwelling or resting or being in Ragh.; Rājat.; Kathās.
सं-श्रयितव्य mfn. to be sought for refuge (as a fortress), Pañcat.
सं-श्रेषिण m. perhaps, ‘the N. of a combat in which Indra is said to have engaged on a certain occasion’, AV.

सं-√ श्रि P. Ā. -श्रयति, ˚ते (aor. -अश्रेत्, RV.), to join together with, furnish with (Ā. ‘to join one's self or connect one's self with’), RV.; AV.; TāṇḍBr.; to join or attach one's self to, go for refuge or succour to, resort or betake one's self to, cling to for protection, seek the help of (acc.), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to approach, go to any one with (instr.), R.; to approach for sexual union, MBh.; to rest or depend on (acc.), Mālatīm.; to obtain, acquire, Mn. x, 60; to serve, MW.
a: संश्रि — {c1c} U. 1 To have recourse to, resort, fly to for refuge or shelter. --2 To lean or rest on, depend on; न खलु बहिरुपाधीन् प्रीतयः संश्रयंते U. 6. 12; Māl. 1. 24. --3 To attain to, approach. --4 To obtain. --5 To serve, wait upon. --6 To join, unite with.

m: सं-श्रि˚तानुराग m. the affection of dependants, MW.

s: tri, (saM + Sri + ktaH .) ASritaH । yaTA, “na pAcImagrataH SamBornodIcIM SaktisaMSritAm । na pratIcIM yataH pfzWamato dakzaM samASrayet ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
m: सं-श्रित mfn. joined or united with (instr. or comp.), AV. &c. &c.
leaning against, clinging to (acc.), MBh.; R.
clung to, embraced, Kum.
one who has gone or fled to any one for protection, one who has entered the service of (acc. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
one who has betaken himself to a place, living or dwelling or staying or situated or being in (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
resorted to, sought for refuge or protection, MBh.
one who is addicted to, indulging in (acc.), Bhag.; Pañcat.
one who has laid hold of or embraced or chosen, MBh.
inherent in, peculiar to (acc. or comp.), MBh.; R.
relating to, concerning (loc. or comp.), ib.; BhP.
suitable, fit, proper, MBh. xii, 4102
सं-श्रित m. a servant, adherent, dependant, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: संश्रित — p. p. 1 Gone to for refuge. --2 Supported, sheltered. --3 United, joined; चूतेन संश्रितवती नवमालिक्रेयं Ś. 4. 12. --तः A dependent, follower, servant.

m: सं-श्रित—वत् mfn. one who has joined or united himself with (instr.), Śak.
सं-˚श्रितव्य w.r. for ˚स्रयितव्य, Pañcat.

सं-√ 1. श्रु P. Ā. -शृणोति, -शृणुते, to hear or hear from (e.g. मुखात्, ‘from any one's mouth’), attend or listen attentively to (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to assent, promise (loc. or dat.), ib.; (Ā.) to be distinctly heard or audible, ŚāṅkhBr. (cf. Pāṇ. i, 3, 29, Vārtt. 2, Pat.) : Pass. -श्रूयते, to be heard or talked about or read about (यथा संश्रूयते, ‘as people say’ or ‘as we read in books’), MBh. : Caus. -श्रावयति, to cause to hear or to be heard, proclaim, announce (नाम, ‘one's name’), relate or report anything (acc.) to any one (acc. or dat.), Yājñ.; to read out (see सं-श्राविश); to make resound, MBh.
a: संश्रु — {c5c} U. 1 To listen to; संशृणोति न चोक्तनि Bk. 5. 19; 6. 5; (but Atm. when used intransitively); हितान्न यः संशृणुते स किंप्रभुः Ki. 1. 5. --2 To promise. --Caus. To tell, narrate, report.

s: tri, (saM + Sru + ktaH .) aNgIkftaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 3 । 10 । 36 । “mayA cEtadvacaH SrutvA kArtsyena paripAlanam । fzoRAM daRqakAraRya saMSrutaM janakAtmaje ॥”)
v: tri॰ sama + Sru--ka । 1 aNgIkfte amaraH । 2 mamyakaSrute ।
m: सं-श्रुत mfn. well heard, learnt, Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
read about in (loc.), MBh.
agreed, promised to (gen.), MBh.; R. &c.
सं-श्रुत m. N. of a man, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 148, Sch.
a: संश्रुत — p. p. 1 Promised, agreed to. --2 Well-heard.

m: सं-˚श्रुत्य m. N. of a son of Viśvāmitra, MBh.
सं-√ शुभ् Ā. -शोभते, to look beautiful, be radiant or splendid, TBr.; MBh.; to shine equally with (instr.), RV. : Caus. -शोभयति, to decorate, adorn, beautify, AV.

सं-√ शुध् P. -शुध्यति, to become completely pure or purified, MW. : Caus. -शोधयति, to purify or cleanse thoroughly, clear, MBh.; Rājat.; to clear (expenses), pay off, R.; Kathās.; to clear, secure (as a road against attack), Mn. vii, 155; to subtract, VarBṛS.; to divide, Gaṇit.
a: संशुध् — {c4c} P. To be completely purified. --Caus. 1 To purify completely. --2 To clear, pay off (expenses). --3 To correct, rectify. --4 To examine, inquire into, investigate.

m: सं-√ शुच् P. -शोचति, to flame or blaze together, ŚBr.; to mourn, regret, bewail, MBh.; (-शुच्यति), to cause pain to (gen.), ŚBr. : Caus. -शोचयति (ind.p. -शोच्य), to mourn, lament, MBh.
सं-शुद्ध mfn. completely purified or cleansed, pure, clean, Yājñ.; BhP.
removed, destroyed, expiated (see comp.)
cleared off, defrayed, paid, Kathās.
searched, tried, examined, Mn. vii, 219
acquitted (of a crime), W.
a: संशुद्ध — p. p. 1 Completely purified, pure. --2 Polished, refined. --3 Expiated. --4 Acquitted (of crime or debt.).

m: सं-शुद्ध—किल्बिष mfn. one whose offences are expiated, purified from sin, Bhag.

s: strI, (saM + SuDa + ktin .) samyak SIDanam । SarIramArjjanam । yaTA, -- samammArjjanaYca saMSudDiH saMSoDanaviSoDane ॥” iti ratnamAlA ॥
v: strI sama + SuDa--ktin । 1 samyakSoDane 2 dehAdimArjane ca ratnaBA॰ ।
m: सं-˚शुद्धि f. perfect purification or purity (also in a ritual sense), Bhag.; Kām.
cleaning (the body), W.
acquittal, acquittance, ib.
correction, rectification, ib.
a: संशुद्धिः — f. 1 Complete purification; Bg. 15. 1. --2 Cleansing or purifying in general. --3 Correction, rectincation. --4 Clearance. --5 Acquittance (of debt). --6 Purity, cleanness.

m: सं-√ 1. शुष् P. -शुष्यति, (ep. also ˚ते), to be completely dried or dried up, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -शोषयति, to make dry, dry up, ib.
सं-शुष्˚कास्य mfn. having a withered face, ib.

s: tri, AtapAdinA saMSozitavastu । saMpUrvvaSuzaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannam ॥
m: सं-शुष्क mf(आ)n. completely dried up or withered, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-शुष्क—मांस-त्वक्-स्नायु mfn. one whose flesh and skin and sinews are completely dried up or withered, MBh.
सं-श्वायिन् mfn. (√ श्वि) swelling (see उभयतः-स्˚).

s: klI, (saM + Svi + atipratyayena nipAtanAt sidDam । “saMpUrvvAt SvayateH saMSvaditi suBUticandraH .” ityuRAdiwIkAyAM ujjvaladattaH । 2 । 85 .) mAyA yaTA, -- “saMScattu kuhake jYeyaM saMSvat tatrEva te mame .” ityuRAdikozaH ॥
m: सं-श्वत् See सं-श्-चत्, col. 1.
a: संश्वत् — See संश्चत्

s: tri, (saM + SyE + ktaH .) SItena saNkucitaH । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥
v: tri॰ sam + syO--kta na sampra॰ । saNkucite ।
m: सं-श्यान mfn. id.
contracted, shrunk or rolled up together, collapsed, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 24.
a: संश्यान — p. p. 1 Contracted, shrunk up. --2 Frozen, congealed. --3 Rolled up. --4 Collapsed.

m: सं-√ श्यै cl. 1. P. Ā. -श्यायति, ˚ते, only in the forms below.
